name: After § 14
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the UN Climate Change Conference 2025 in Belém, Brazil (COP30)
part_text: 14b. Recognises that the EU played a significant role in brokering a deal to achieve the NCQG; calls for all Parties, in particular the EU, when financing the NCQG, to prioritise grant-based financing; calls on financial institutions to refocus on their original mission of ensuring macroeconomic stability and development, and, when developing projects, to ensure their effectiveness, transparency and financial sustainability;
